items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because Kuyper was there for a while. ... [INTERVIEWEE] When I was in there it was a guitar player... He taught René Hall and all them for that.

ctx.x: Let's see, who had that band that worked at the tenors? No, it was the Louis Daniels. No, wait, what year you was playing at? Oh, I don't know yet. I'll be frank, that's one thing I don't know yet.
Because Kuyper was there for a while. When I was at the tenors? No, no, no. You came after the kind of thing.

When I was in there it was a guitar player, a band-a-gill player's job. For that one? For that one. He taught René Hall and all them for that. He was a very good band-a-gill player and guitar player. What was his name? Willie what? Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Yeah. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie…
